The '''pirate''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW135|Mystery on a Deserted Island!]]''. As the name suggests, he was a pirate and the leader of a gang of Pokémon who inhabit a [[Deserted Island (BW135)|deserted island]] near [[Frond Island]].

The pirate is depicted in a museum painting. He first appeared in a flashback when [[Alexa]] told {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} the story about how she found information about a hidden treasure while she went to a pirate museum; this treasure belonged to the pirate. Alexa told the group that he hid his treasure somewhere in the [[Decolore Islands]] and the deserted island they were heading to happened to be one of them. Afterwards, the pirate left behind a map, which Alexa retrieved while conducting some research.

While on the deserted island, the group realized many of the Pokémon living there were actually the pirate's Pokémon, including a {{p|Ninetales}} that had been his {{p|Vulpix}}, which was now guarding the treasure. After solving several puzzles, the group located the pirate's treasure, a chest full of [[Evolution stone]]s, in a hidden chamber within a mountain.
